facts.fact: The authority gave opinion n° 2021-002 of 25 November 2021 on the draft decree authorising national video-protection (CCTV) data processing by the interior ministry; a general opinion, with no decision on a named controller or count of decisions.
facts.system: Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel (APDP)

facts.fact: The decree of 16 February 2022 is taken under the code du numérique, law n° 2017-20 of 20 April 2018 as amended by law n° 2020-35 of 6 January 2021, which it cites as its legal basis and applies to the processing it authorises.
facts.system: Code du numérique (loi n° 2017-20, as amended by loi n° 2020-35)

facts.fact: Decree 2022-107 of 16 February 2022 cites an opinion n° 2021-002 of 25 November 2021 of the Autorité de Protection des Données personnelles, which also has to be consulted before the video-protection database is interconnected and whose seal marks the public notices.
facts.system: Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel (APDP)
